_comment: Manual review corrections applied to yolo11s draft predictions (conf=0.15) on the 9 images in data/own_photos/raw/. 'keep' lists which draft detection indices are real (others were false positives, e.g. a fan and a glove misfired as 'helmet'). 'class_overrides' maps {index: corrected_class_id} for detections that were right about location but wrong about class (a cloth cap misclassified as helmet, corrected to head=1). See reports/own_photos/README.md for the full methodology and its recall-bias limitation.
